t_122:
ÉLARA began in a two-room atelier in Lisbon with a simple
                  frustration: beautiful dresses were either disposable or
                  unaffordable. We set out to make a third option — pieces cut
                  in small runs, from mills we visit ourselves, at prices that
                  reflect the cloth rather than the logo. (ES)
t_123:
Every silhouette is fitted on real bodies across five sizes
                  before it goes into production, and every seam is finished by
                  hand. We release two collections a year, not twelve, because
                  good design needs time to settle. (ES)
